verdict.rationale: The Amazon Chime SDK is a real-time communications SDK and service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes show AI-readable documentation, which is an adjacent feature and not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
